description: This file implements linked list management functions for pattern nodes used in telemetry analysis. It provides functions to insert, search, compare, print, delete, and clear nodes of type pcdata_t, including memory management and utility functions.

methods.name: int insertPCNode(GList ** pch,char * pattern,char * header,DType_t dtype,int count,char * data,bool trim,char * regex)
methods.description: Inserts a new pattern node at the beginning of the list, copying pattern and header strings, setting data type, count, data, and regex parameters.

methods.name: gint comparePattern(gconstpointer np,gconstpointer sp)
methods.description: Compares a pattern node with a search pattern to find if the pattern exists within the search string.

methods.name: pcdata_t * searchPCNode(GList * pch,char * pattern)
methods.description: Searches for a node in the pattern list that matches the specified pattern.

methods.name: void print_pc_node(gpointer data,gpointer user_data)
methods.description: Debug function that prints details of a pattern node.

methods.name: void printPCNodes(GList * pch)
methods.description: Prints all nodes in the pattern list for debugging.

methods.name: void freePCNode(gpointer node)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a pattern node, including its strings.

methods.name: void clearPCNodes(GList ** pch)
methods.description: Clears and frees all nodes in the pattern list.

ctags.name: insertPCNode
ctags.pattern: /^int insertPCNode(GList **pch, char *pattern, char *header, DType_t dtype, int count, char *data,/
ctags.signature: (GList ** pch,char * pattern,char * header,DType_t dtype,int count,char * data,bool trim,char * regex)
